001package bank.service;
002
003import bank.model.Account;
004import bank.model.CheckingAccount;
005
006import java.math.BigDecimal;
007
008/**
009 * ============================================================================
010 *  OverdraftPolicy.java
011 *  Owner            : Max Pribac        (mpribac@umbc.edu)
012 *  Debugger / Tester: Ramya Bommakanti  (ramyab1@umbc.edu)
013 * ============================================================================
014 *
015 *  ROLE:
016 *      One central place that decides what happens when a checking account
017 *      would dip below zero. Two questions:
018 *
019 *        1. Can this withdrawal go through?    (canWithdraw)
020 *        2. If we went negative, is there a fee?  (overdraftFeeFor)
021 *
022 *  WHY A SEPARATE CLASS:
023 *      Keeps the account classes simple. Bank rules tend to change ("waive
024 *      fees for VIPs", "first overdraft per month is free") — having one place
025 *      to change them is much nicer than scattering rules everywhere.
026 * ============================================================================
027 */
028public class OverdraftPolicy {
029
030    /** Fee charged when a checking account dips below zero. */
031    private final BigDecimal overdraftFee = new BigDecimal("35.00");
032
033    /**
034     * Returns true if the account can support this withdrawal.
035     * - CheckingAccount: allowed down to its overdraft limit.
036     * - Savings / Loan:  let the account's own debit() rule decide later.
037     */
038    public boolean canWithdraw(Account account, BigDecimal amount) {
039        if (account instanceof CheckingAccount) {
040            CheckingAccount checking = (CheckingAccount) account;
041            BigDecimal projected = account.getBalance().subtract(amount);
042            BigDecimal floor = checking.getOverdraftLimit().negate();
043            return projected.compareTo(floor) >= 0;
044        }
045        return true;
046    }
047
048    /**
049     * Returns the fee to charge if this withdrawal causes the account to go
050     * below zero. Returns BigDecimal.ZERO if no fee applies.
051     *
052     * Logic:
053     *   - Balance was &gt;= 0 before AND will be &lt; 0 after  → charge the fee.
054     *   - Otherwise → no fee.
055     */
056    public BigDecimal overdraftFeeFor(Account account, BigDecimal amount) {
057        if (!(account instanceof CheckingAccount)) {
058            return BigDecimal.ZERO;
059        }
060        BigDecimal before = account.getBalance();
061        BigDecimal after  = before.subtract(amount);
062        boolean wentNegative = before.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) >= 0
063                && after.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) < 0;
064        return wentNegative ? overdraftFee : BigDecimal.ZERO;
065    }
066
067    /** The flat fee charged on overdraft (exposed for tests / display). */
068    public BigDecimal getOverdraftFee() {
069        return overdraftFee;
070    }
071}
